fact: Judicalex says it has digitised the hearing roll, now online, and all decisions of the Conakry commercial court since its creation, including judgments and orders.

Guinea's UCEP published the award on 5 October 2026 of a 12-month, USD 26,400 consultancy, signed 7 September 2026, to set up, manage and optimise the Tribunal de Commerce de Conakry's integrated management, archiving and digital communication system, with its website, case-law database and IT estate.
system: système intégré de gestion, d'archivage et de communication numérique du Tribunal de Commerce de Conakry
